name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
summary: An open protocol for connecting AI applications to external tools, data sources, and systems through a standardized client-server interface, decoupling agent logic from integration-specific code.

name: OpenAI Function / Tool Calling
summary: A structured way for a model to request a specific function be called with specific arguments, letting an application wire model output directly to real code execution.

name: Semantic Kernel
summary: Microsoft's open-source SDK for building AI agents and multi-agent orchestration, with first-class support for plugins, planners, and enterprise integration.

name: Amazon Bedrock Agents
summary: A managed capability within Bedrock for building agents that plan multi-step tasks, call APIs/knowledge bases, and maintain session context, without managing the orchestration loop directly.

name: LangGraph-style Agent Orchestration
summary: An open-source, graph-based approach to defining agent control flow (state, branches, loops) independent of any single model vendor.

name: Structured Output / JSON Mode
summary: A model API capability that constrains generation to a specified schema (JSON Schema or similar), so application code can rely on well-formed structured output instead of parsing free text.

source.title: Structured output / JSON mode — cross-vendor capability
source.reference: Available across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini APIs under similar names.
